description: Minimal product lifecycle contract for AllinCMS Server Action operations.
createPayloadRule: 2026-09-04 stable create payload B1/B2: product create accepts exactly the 10 contract fields plus siteId (missing and extra fields are refused). media must be non-null flat URL media (name, type='image', source='url', absolute http/https url; never path/size/mimeType) or flat OSS media (name, type='image', source='oss', path, non-negative integer size, mimeType; never url); mediaList is a dense array of the same union; a string/null alt is normalized to missing; the {type,value} editor wrapper is a readback-comparison shape only and is refused on the write path. The one prepared snapshot (prepareStableCreatePayload in content-mutation-primitives.mjs) plus its immutable canonical payloadText are the request payload, the authorization payload_digest input (SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 payloadText), and the native wire body [payloadText]; the host driver prepares synchronously before any await/provider/auth and the bottom layer re-prepares idempotently. The adapter's byte guarantee ends at the input of the host request callback.
readbackWrapperRule: create readback media may be flat or one {type,value} wrapper whose outer type must agree with the wrapped and expected effective type; the wrapper is comparison-only and never re-enters the write path.
boundary: Local contract only; live deployment qualification requires fresh live_verified_current_deployment evidence.
